closing.proceduresNote: The procedures that have been accepted by the type certificate or TSO authorization holder and its cognizant FAA certification branch, for minor changes to original articles used on type-certificated products, are also acceptable for incorporating the same minor changes on identical PMA replacement articles. The PMA holder must be able to show traceability relating to the TC, STC, or TSO authorization holder on all minor changes incorporated by this procedure. When these procedures are no longer applicable because of completion of the production contract, or termination of the licensing agreement or business relationship, all subsequent minor design changes to the PMA articles must be submitted in a manner as determined by the certification branch. Major design changes (reference 14 CFR 21.319 and 21.619) to drawings and specifications are to be handled in the same manner as that for an original PMA.

formattingRules.rule: Times New Roman 12pt, bold for table titles.
Times New Roman 12pt for the core of the supplement.
No '.' in the Model Eligibility column unless part of the model number.
Do not insert page breaks; maintain one contiguous table regardless of page count.
Do not use wording different from the FAA Orders and sample supplement.
One article name and number per row; do not add extra fields, rows, or columns.
Header and page-number footer must appear on every page.
Aim for <= 10 pages; if exceeded, notify the FAA office of the total page count.
